status: Calibrated rows: coefficients = GB300 per-rank 'hot' fits of a MegaMoE MoE-only micro-benchmark (real DSV4-Pro layers, bucket = T, eager); activity model fitted on real DSV4 decode routing thinned to the per-bucket loads of the tuned deployments. Refit cf / cl / cc / ch / a on the CUDA-graph decode kernel (bucket 256) before trusting absolute numbers (the warm-up micro-benchmark, costmb.py, does this per run); rmse_us null until then.
tier_rule: one rule for coefficients and pricing: the row of the largest key <= T (T = the balancer's T, max real decode rows of one replay on any rank); T below the smallest key takes the smallest row (flagged extrapolated)

fields.cf: us per active copy (first 256-row tile: one 37.16 MB NVFP4 weight stream)
fields.cl: us per extra 256-row tile on any copy
fields.ch: us per extra tile of the rank's hottest copy
fields.a: us fixed per layer (not used by the objective; kept for absolute predictions)
fields.act_k: negative-binomial shape of a copy's rows per replay: P(active) = 1 - (1 + (x + lam0) / k)^-k
fields.act_lam0: rows per replay added to every expert's window rate (8-replay estimates regress to the mean; zero-load homes are active 8-11 % of the next steps)
fields.tile_disp: variance / mean of a copy's rows for the later-tile expectation (as the shipped poisson presets)
fields.gate_margin_us: a split or plan must beat identity (home-only routing) by this many us per layer-step
fields.per_rank: placement flex: replicas (options) per home rank
fields.keep_bonus: placement flex: a held replica's expert ranks as if its rate were (1 + keep_bonus) x higher
fields.new_penalty_us: placement greedy (experimental): a new replica must beat a held one by this
